reason: I already look up my named breach on Top Class Actions, and I am not making an account with a startup after having my data stolen. You still send me to the administrator to file myself, so I do not see why I would leave the site I already use.
objection: I will not give a startup my address or phone. A free-during-beta account is how that starts, and Top Class Actions already does this without that.
would_change_my_mind: If I could search my breach by name with no account, no address, and no phone, and you showed me an official claim Top Class Actions does not have, I might click through once. I still would not sign up or pay.
